purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask which coding agent works best on the user's own code, or what it costs per fix there; near misses belong to sibling skills or to no skill.

cases.prompt: which coding agent works best on my codebase, Claude Code or Codex?
cases.assert: Mines tasks with mine_tasks.py, shows the estimate, asks for a dollar cap before any run.

cases.prompt: benchmark Claude Code against Codex on my own repository
cases.assert: Validates tasks from git history, then runs drive.py with an explicit --max-usd.

cases.prompt: compare coding agents on real bugs from my git history
cases.assert: Runs mine_tasks.py --validate and reports the fixes per harness.

cases.prompt: I want to trial Gemini CLI before switching from Claude Code
cases.assert: Explains that Gemini CLI cannot be priced and runs only with --allow-unpriced gemini-cli after the user agrees.

cases.prompt: what does each agent cost per fixed bug on this project
cases.assert: Leads with the headline 'On N tasks from your git history, ... passed ... at $Y each'.

cases.prompt: test drive Codex and Claude Code on my past commits
cases.assert: Uses the commit messages as prompts and the repository's tests as the score.

cases.prompt: SWE-bench leaderboards say nothing about my repo, how do I compare harnesses on my own code
cases.assert: Runs the mine, estimate, cap, run, report sequence.

cases.prompt: how much did my agent sessions cost last month
cases.assert: Belongs to session-waste-report: spend from past session transcripts.

cases.prompt: stop the agent when it spends more than ten dollars
cases.assert: Belongs to runaway-guard: a live session cap.

cases.prompt: did Claude Code get worse after the last update
did the agent really run the tests before it said they passed
which instruction files does Codex load from this repo
list the price per million tokens for Claude and GPT models
cases.assert: No skill: a pricing lookup, not a test drive.
